name: Halvern Steel Safeguard Order

components.cap_unit: ad valorem, share of customs value, for three years
source_sentences: Importers of record must pay a tariff of 25% of the customs value on imports of flat-rolled and long steel products, for three years.
Imported fabricated steel products and finished goods containing steel (machinery, vehicles, appliances, fabricated structural sections, fasteners) are not covered.
A review in the third year may extend it.
Steel users may apply to exclude a product "not produced domestically in sufficient quantity or quality".

unclear.text: The standard for 'sufficient quantity or quality' in the exclusion process (K2).
readings: U1-a: applied case by case, with weight given to objections from domestic steelmakers
U1-b: applied by a fixed domestic-capacity test

context: Three domestic steel firms supply about 60% of the steel used in Halvern; the rest is imported (WE-013 record).
About 4,000 domestic manufacturers use steel as a main input; machinery makers export about 35% of their output (WE-013 record).
The mills buy scrap, ore and energy as inputs, and their shares are held by owners (WE-013 table, C-21 and C-23; not stated in the order's text).
Halvern buys a small share of the world's steel and has a floating exchange rate (WE-013 record).
